title: Dodge Challenger SRT Super Stock

scenes.headline: Matte Black Hood Scoops
scenes.narration: Performance is at the core of the Challenger SRT Super Stock, especially with its matte black hood featuring functional air scoops.

scenes.headline: Wide-Body Fenders
scenes.narration: The Super Stock's wide-body fenders aren't just for looks; they house performance-ready tires essential for minimizing drag on the track.

scenes.headline: Rear Wing Aerodynamics
scenes.narration: Dodge equips this beast with a rear wing, enhancing its aerodynamics and keeping it planted at high speeds.

scenes.headline: 807 HP Supercharged HEMI
scenes.narration: The heart of this monster is the 807 horsepower supercharged HEMI V8, delivering 707 lb-ft of torque.

scenes.headline: High-Flow Intake System
scenes.narration: The high-flow air intake, highlighted by its unique red filter, ensures optimum airflow to the mighty HEMI engine.

scenes.headline: Beats Mustang Shelby
scenes.narration: Taking on the Ford Mustang Shelby GT500, which has 760 horsepower, the Super Stock stands out with more muscle and character.

scenes.headline: Red Leather Aesthetic
scenes.narration: Inside, the red leather seats with SRT stitching provide both luxury and a nod to its performance roots.

scenes.headline: Aerodynamic Mastery
scenes.narration: For an original MSRP of around $80K, it's astonishing that the Super Stock holds its value so well, trading close to $60K now.

scenes.headline: Ultimate Dragster
scenes.narration: The Challenger SRT Super Stock is not just a muscle car; it's a statement.

script: Performance is at the core of the Challenger SRT Super Stock, especially with its matte black hood featuring functional air scoops. The Super Stock's wide-body fenders aren't just for looks; they house performance-ready tires essential for minimizing drag on the track. Dodge equips this beast with a rear wing, enhancing its aerodynamics and keeping it planted at high speeds. The heart of this monster is the 807 horsepower supercharged HEMI V8, delivering 707 lb-ft of torque. The high-flow air intake, highlighted by its unique red filter, ensures optimum airflow to the mighty HEMI engine. Taking on the Ford Mustang Shelby GT500, which has 760 horsepower, the Super Stock stands out with more muscle and character. Inside, the red leather seats with SRT stitching provide both luxury and a nod to its performance roots. For an original MSRP of around $80K, it's astonishing that the Super Stock holds its value so well, trading close to $60K now. The Challenger SRT Super Stock is not just a muscle car; it's a statement.
